question: What offerings are presented to the lord of gods after bowing in reverence?
premises: The king bows to the god, the lord of gods.
An offering is directed to him.
The offering includes villages and so forth and gold.
inference: After bowing to the lord of gods, the king presents offerings such as villages and gold.
uncertainties: Whether grāmādi kāñcanam is given to the deity, the temple, or the teacher is implied by ritual context.
plain_english: Having bowed to the god, the lord of gods, he should offer to him villages and so forth and gold.
